title: 3D-printed rotary triboelectric nanogenerators based on a cam-drive structure for wind energy harvesting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,5085-5095
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00356C, Paper
Shuyue You, Wei Zhao, Lisheng Du, Junyang Ma, Yaxiong Qin, Kun Du, Dan Zhao, Bo Zhang
A cam-drive structured triboelectric nanogenerator (C-TENG) was developed via 3D printing technology, effectively converting wind-induced rotational motion into periodic contact-separation between triboelectric materials for harvesting energy.
